articles.title: The Rock Sings a Sweet Song for His Daughters
articles.summary: Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson has a new song called 'Your Dad' for his three daughters. He co-wrote it with American Idol winner Iam Tongi. The video shows home movies of him with his girls!

articles.title: New Cinderella Movie 'Steps' Gets a Famous Composer
articles.summary: Kris Bowers will write the music for Netflix's new animated movie 'Steps,' a twist on Cinderella's evil stepsisters. It comes out November 20. The score was recorded at Abbey Road Studios!

articles.title: Wait, Aretha Franklin Made a Secret Super-Album?
articles.summary: A forgotten 1976 movie soundtrack has Aretha Franklin singing her heart out. It's called Sparkle, and one song, "Something He Can Feel," hit No. 1 on the R&B chart. Why isn't this album a bigger deal?
